# Contributing & Community Guidelines

Thank you for visiting **CatWardrive**!

### Contributions Policy
- **Direct commits and Pull Requests are not accepted.** Any Pull Requests opened will be automatically closed.
- The project is maintained as a focused release distribution for Flipper Zero.

### Feedback, Comments & Questions
We actively welcome discussions, feedback, and user reports!
- To ask questions, share hardware builds, or start a topic: Join our **[Discussions](https://github.com/EVL87/catwardrive/discussions)**.
- To report bugs or compatibility notes: Open an **[Issue](https://github.com/EVL87/catwardrive/issues)**.
